notes.title: Update 5.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new update is finally here!

Added new Savages and Animals combat system.
Added new golem and bigger mountain dragon, health bars will be displayed when fighting with bigger creatures.
Added a savage with dynamite.
There will be more creatures added in new updates, and new AI systems can be adjusted and balanced.
Update 5.1 is expected to be released next month.

The Hotbar now has 7 slots instead of 5, now you can equip items with mouse scroll.
Increased nighttime duration and brightness.
Werewolves and flying creatures will be spawned during the night after a few days, but players can skip the night by sleeping.
You can sell animals anywhere by pressing X, but at a lower price.

Removed horse carriage, it will be returned in the future.
Removed Defense mode, it will be replaced with a new mode in the future
Reduced hunting rifle and shotgun damage, and hunting rifle clip size to 3.
Fixed: Hunting rifle and crossbow aiming animation, the aiming wasn't 100% accurate.
Fixed: If the game is paused for a long time, the AI ​​will get stuck.

Saved files will be deleted after this update.

Savages will attack the player base less often than before.

Reduced Savages speed from 8 to 7.

If you think something should be changed in the game, feel free to write a comment. I need feedback from the players, thanks.
